title: The satisfying assignment meets every literal
statement: Let $T$ be a DNF term on $n$ coordinates, and let $j$ be a position in its list of literals. The satisfying assignment of $T$, evaluated at the coordinate indexed by the literal in position $j$, equals the binary value corresponding to that literal's required sign.
